The [[Gentik]]/[[Columni]] '''AX-1 Espionage Brain''' was a custom-built [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] that was part of the espionage package that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] placed into modified [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6-series repair droids]] that allowed them to function as effective [[Spy/Legends|spies]].<ref name="CRO" />
